snippet.title: LISA THE HEARTLESS Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Gamejolt Page: https://gamejolt.com/games/heartless/856468

Discord for game updates: https://discord.gg/devExPZMGm
My Twitter: https://twitter.com/dystercat

The demo of Heartless is nigh! Please remember that this is a demo, and doesn't represent the full product. It is a tasting of the final result, upon its release. Naturally, everything is subject to change, and certain things in the story may not make sense just yet...

Features:
-Explore Haven Island, a desolate fracture of Olathe far removed from the mainland.
-4-5 hours of content, with three difficulty settings.
-Three main characters with distinct motivations, play styles and personalities.
-Unforgiving, delicately balanced gameplay. Keen strategists and explorers are rewarded. The weak suffer.
-Soul-crushing ambience and adrenaline-fuelled combat songs all in almost 40 tracks!
-A ludicrous amount of secrets. You will not find them all.
-Distinct emphasis on atmosphere - see all the beauty, and all the rot, in it's rawest form.

Be warned! Heartless is a game of difficulty. You will certainly struggle if you rush in with no plan. Strategy is key to survival. Not every fight is meant to be brute forced upon discovery. You may suffer and toil, scraping by from battle to battle — or you may thrive and crush all who dare oppose you in your crusade to victory.  You will encounter all sorts of opponents with varying weaknesses and strengths. Use everything to your disposal.

Have fun! Let me know what you think! 

Trailer made by Arclight, thumbnail by Adejny.
